Maybe the mechanic is: clicking a dot makes the token move 1 step toward that dot (if on the line). Clicking (45,18) should have moved it 1 step to (51,12)... but it didn't. Unless the click has to be within a certain distance.
Or: the token moves to the clicked dot only if it's the next dot (adjacent). Let me test: click (49,14) — the next dot from the current position (51,12). If the token moves to (49,14), the rule is "click the next dot to advance."
